[[File:Glowbacters.jpg|200px|thumb|Glowbacters]]
'''Glowbacters''' were metal lanterns that were used by members of [[the Doomed]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] community consisting of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who had become stranded on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] planet of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] following the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]]. Metal was rare on Kesh so these lanterns were made from their wrecked [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. In [[2974 BBY]], the two [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] [[Parlan Spinner]] and [[Takara Hilts]] came into contact with glowbacters during their first meeting with the Doomed at the [[City of the Doomed]].
